findings.title: AI crawler 'GPTBot' blocked by robots.txt
findings.evidence: robots.txt Disallow rule prevents GPTBot (OpenAI's GPT crawler) from accessing: /, /products, /blog, /pricing, /about, /faq, /shop. Full robots.txt snippet contains User-agent: GPTBot.

suggested_action.summary: Review the Disallow rules for 'GPTBot' in robots.txt. If you want AI assistants to cite your content, remove or narrow these rules. To allow all AI crawlers: ensure no User-agent block covers GPTBot, anthropic-ai, or Google-Extended without a compensating Allow rule.

findings.title: 86.0% of content on /sitemap absent from raw HTML
findings.evidence: Raw HTML: 236 words. Playwright-rendered: 487 words. Render gap: 86.0% of rendered words absent from raw crawler view. Affected URL: https://nytimes.com/sitemap

suggested_action.summary: Implement SSR or SSG so content is in the initial HTML response. At minimum, ensure product names, prices, and key facts appear in raw HTML. Use Next.js getServerSideProps/getStaticProps or equivalent.

findings.title: Phone number inconsistency — 3 distinct values across pages
findings.evidence: Found 3 different phone numbers across 15 pages. Details: '2125568034' on 1 page(s): https://nytimes.com/section/jobs; '8002384637' on 1 page(s): https://nytimes.com/section/jobs; '8007537795' on 1 page(s): https://nytimes.com/subscription/groups?Pardot_Campaign_Code_Form_Input=89FQX. Inconsistent contact info causes AI models to distrust the site's data.

suggested_action.summary: Standardize the phone number in a single CMS variable or component. Use E.164 format (e.g., +1-800-555-0100) in JSON-LD 'telephone' field. Ensure all page templates reference the same source of truth.

findings.title: No content freshness signals found on any page
findings.evidence: Checked 14 pages. 0 pages contain dateModified, datePublished (JSON-LD), article:modified_time, or og:updated_time (meta tags). AI crawlers cannot determine whether this site's content is current.

suggested_action.summary: Add datePublished and dateModified to all Article/BlogPosting JSON-LD. Add <meta property='article:modified_time' content='...ISO date...'> to all content pages. Include <lastmod> dates in your sitemap.xml.

findings.title: No Organization JSON-LD found on any crawled page
findings.evidence: Crawled 12 pages. No JSON-LD with @type Organization, LocalBusiness, or equivalent was found. AI assistants use Organization markup as the primary entity anchor for a brand.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD to your homepage with: name, legalName, url, description, logo, sameAs, contactPoint. Reference: https://schema.org/Organization

findings.title: Blog/article pages detected but no Article JSON-LD found
findings.evidence: URL patterns suggest this site has blog or article pages, but no Article or BlogPosting JSON-LD was found. AI assistants rely on Article markup to properly attribute authored content.

suggested_action.summary: Add Article or BlogPosting JSON-LD to all blog posts with: headline, datePublished, dateModified, author (Person with name), image.

findings.title: Multiple distinct email addresses (3) found across site
findings.evidence: Found 3 distinct email addresses: 'nytjobs@nytimes.com', 'businesscare@nytimes.com', 'groupsubs@nytimes.com'. While multiple emails may be intentional, excessive variety can confuse AI knowledge graphs.

suggested_action.summary: Confirm these email addresses are all intentional. For primary contact, use a single canonical email in Organization JSON-LD 'email' field.

findings.title: sameAs present but missing high-trust disambiguators: Wikidata, Crunchbase
findings.evidence: Found sameAs links to: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Wikipedia, Twitter/X. Missing high-trust identity anchors: Wikidata, Crunchbase. Wikidata/Wikipedia/Crunchbase entries are the strongest signals for AI entity resolution.

suggested_action.summary: Add the following to your sameAs array: Wikidata, Crunchbase. If no Wikidata entry exists for your brand, create one at https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Special:NewItem

findings.title: No About/Company page found
findings.evidence: Checked paths: /about, /about-us, /company, /who-we-are, /our-story. None returned HTTP 200. An About page is a key identity signal that AI models use to understand a brand's purpose and distinguish it from peers.

suggested_action.summary: Create an /about page with: company name (full legal name), founding year, headquarters location, industry/vertical, mission statement, and key differentiators. Include at least 3 specific disambiguating facts.

findings.title: 3/62 internal links are broken (4.8%)
findings.evidence: Checked 62 unique internal link targets; 3 returned HTTP 4xx/5xx. Sample broken URLs: https://nytimes.com/video (HTTP 0); https://nytimes.com/weather (HTTP 0); https://nytimes.com/books/best-sellers (HTTP 0).

suggested_action.summary: Set up 301 redirects for moved content. Delete or update links to removed pages. Add a link-checking step to your CI/CD pipeline (e.g., lychee, broken-link-checker). Configure your CMS to warn editors when linking to non-existent pages.
